nodes.description: Private counter used to assign sequential token IDs when minting forward.
Private counter used to assign token IDs from the top when minting in reverse direction.
Public counter tracking number of team-reserve NFTs already minted.
Immutable address of the OpenSea proxy registry used in isApprovedForAll.
Ownable private owner address controlling privileged functions.
Payable public mint function; validates price via getNFTPrice and mints up to 20 NFTs to msg.sender.
Owner-only function minting team-reserve tokens up to TEAM_RESERVE, updating reserveMintedCount.
Owner-only function transferring entire contract balance to msg.sender.
View function returning current NFT price based on current supply tiers.
Overrides approval check, consulting external proxyRegistry and falling back to super.
Owner-only function that reassigns the contract owner.
Internal function minting a token then invoking onERC721Received on recipient contracts.
Private function performing an external functionCall to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient.
Ownable modifier enforcing that the caller equals the stored owner.
Caller-controlled address used for minting recipient and withdrawal destination.
Low-level ETH transfer of entire balance to msg.sender inside withdraw.
External call to recipient contract during _safeMint enabling reentrancy before state finalization.
Caller-supplied NFT quantity parameter of mintNFT.
Owner-supplied quantity parameter of mintTeamReserve.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Local caching of address(this).balance inside withdraw.
Local token ID computed from mint direction inside mintNFT and mintTeamReserve loops.
Local 0/1 value derived from blockhash and totalSupply selecting forward or reverse minting.

edges.reason: numberOfNfts parameter bounds the mint loop count in mintNFT.
count parameter drives the reserve mint loop in mintTeamReserve.
newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged owner in transferOwnership.
balance local is read from contract balance in withdraw.
mintIndex local determines the token ID minted in mintNFT.
mintDirection local controls forward/reverse token ID selection in mintNFT.
mintDirection local controls forward/reverse token ID selection in mintTeamReserve.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in mintNFT.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in mintTeamReserve.
msg.sender receives the entire contract balance in the withdraw transfer.
Owner check compares stored _owner against msg.sender.
msg.sender is forwarded as operator argument to onERC721Received.
onlyOwner modifier links owner identity to the calling untrusted account.
External onERC721Received call is made from _checkOnERC721Received granting control to the recipient.
_checkOnERC721Received triggers the unsafe external call during safe minting.
mintNFT calls _safeMint which performs the external receiver callback.
mintTeamReserve calls _safeMint enabling recipient callback reentrancy.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received after minting the token.
mintNFT reads price from getNFTPrice to validate msg.value.
mintNFT increments forwardMintIndex when minting forward.
mintNFT decrements reverseMintIndex when minting in reverse.
mintTeamReserve increments forwardMintIndex when minting forward.
mintTeamReserve decrements reverseMintIndex when minting in reverse.
mintTeamReserve accumulates reserveMintedCount before minting.
withdraw is restricted to the owner identified by msg.sender.
withdraw executes a full-balance ETH transfer to the caller.
transferOwnership authorization depends on msg.sender matching _owner.
mintTeamReserve authorization depends on msg.sender matching _owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates privileged functions on msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner state variable.
proxyRegistryAddress is queried in isApprovedForAll for OpenSea proxy whitelisting.
isApprovedForAll performs an external call to proxyRegistry.proxies returning operator delegation.

normalization_plan.reason: Caller quantity parameter only meaningful within mintNFT mint loop.
Owner quantity parameter only meaningful within mintTeamReserve reserve loop.
New owner address parameter is only used when updating owner state.
Local balance cache only exists to feed the withdraw ETH transfer.
Local token ID is computed and consumed inside the mintNFT loop.
Local direction selector only affects token ID ordering during minting.
